items.question: Is the printed undotted upper Eb5 half intentional, or is a dot missing before its tie to P93?
items.provisional_treatment: Retain written half length 2 at onset 3/2, no invented visible rest, and the printed outgoing tie. Playback sustains the explicit tie through the gap; the encoding checker flags that relationship for human interpretation.

items.question: Confirm the small ascending figure’s performance against the held D#3/F##3 chord and the fermatas.
items.provisional_treatment: Preserve the printed small eighth/eighth/eighth/dotted-quarter values in a separate line against both dotted-half chord members. No unmeasured duration or editorial tempo is asserted.

items.question: Review the diagnostic CORE rebuild’s extension of the half note to a dotted half; do not substitute that file for the primary.
items.provisional_treatment: Keep the print-preserving primary. Actual CORE Apply is byte-exact; a fresh independent rebuild extends this one tied-gap note from 2 to 3 quarters. Retain the raw failed equality result.
items.reason_for_uncertainty: The rebuild normalizes the written gap under the outgoing tie; the unresolved print interpretation is MUS-P092.

items.provisional_treatment: Retain both fp dynamics in MusicXML. MARKS export warns at these two positions; actual MARKS Apply retains both, all pitches/ties, articulation placement and the full multiset of exact slur endpoints/styles. Do not claim all marks are text-editable.

items.review_safety_reason: The corrected primary is unchanged, PROPER, and independently passes playback/member/cursor checks. Diagnostic reconstructions are not the primary.

items.question: Check curve spacing, particularly the P47 upper phrase crossing stems and the thin long ties in the dense closing passages.
items.provisional_treatment: Retain the printed member endpoints and current production engraving. P47 is a same-staff phrase crossing voice roles; the adapter reports ink intersections. Long ties remain visible close to staff lines.
items.readability_reason: The curves and their endpoints can still be followed; pitches, note values and staff ownership remain visible and pass member-level checks. This is retained for human engraving acceptance, not a claim of collision-free geometry.

items.question: Check the vertical placement of polyphonic rests against the print, especially the upper bass-staff rests at P48–49.
items.provisional_treatment: Keep each printed rest and its exact voice/onset/duration. The production renderer places some secondary rests away from their original visual lane.
items.readability_reason: Every rest is visible on the correct staff and its timing is verified. Noteheads are distinguishable; the remaining question is the visual association of a rest with its independent line.

items.question: Check spacing of adjacent crescendo/diminuendo wedges and nearby dynamics.
items.provisional_treatment: Retain separate printed swell spans; compact rendering brings some open ends or text close together.
items.readability_reason: The crescendo and diminuendo shapes remain visible and distinguishable; the question is presentation polish and acceptance of spacing.
